question: Does the public archive contain directly measured cells at an explicitly documented factor-off endpoint?

analysis: Verify hashes, sparse matrix dimensions, nonnegative integer counts, unique sample-scoped barcodes and observed marker distributions. Apply simple library >0 QC only. No cell-type labels are inferred for whole-liver aggregate summaries.

destructive single-cell snapshot does not follow the same cell
pooled library composition is not donor replication
promotion: Cannot close any human CX004 readout. Provides a reusable observed withdrawal analogue and methods fixture.
